svg.title: Tool Output Limits: reduce large tool results once, when they arrive
svg.desc: ToolOutputLimits runs in the after_tool_execute hook, on a tool result before it enters the history. With the default band, a 48,000-character result is spilled: the full payload is written to the workspace store under .pydantic-ai-harness/tool-output/, and the model gets a short marker with the handle and a head and tail preview. The model reads slices back with the read_tool_result tool.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
